## What's Changed

- Added strict TOML configuration with environment overrides and config-relative paths.
- Added configurable console and file logging with sensitive-value redaction.
- Limited Explore to 50 results per page and 100 per search while preserving full-scope totals and histograms.
- Improved title readability in dark mode.
- Updated setup, packaging, and developer documentation for the new configuration and result limits.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/InvestiGenie/investigenie/compare/0.4.2...0.5.0
